A weekend of love, laughter & celebration ↓
A rather wonderful crossover

Kerala meets
Uttar Pradesh.

A Malayali girl from Kerala and a Marwari boy from Prayagraj were brought together in Udaipur, and a most unexpected cultural crossover was set in motion.

Two worlds. One celebration.

A little Kerala.
A little Marwari.
A lot of love.

Different cultures. Different personalities. One very good reason to celebrate.

A Kerala wedding, a Marwari celebration, two families and a rather enthusiastic guest list are being brought together over one unforgettable weekend. Tradition is being mixed with laughter, food, music and just the right amount of chaos.
